description: Oxygen Not Included's Unity layer reimplemented on the BRUTAL framework (.NET 10 CoreCLR), around 8x the original frame rate on a late-game colony
notes: Moono replaces the game's Unity layer instead of patching it, so it can't be installed as a Harmony mod.
Run the bundled setup once (and again after each update) to copy the player to %LOCALAPPDATA%\oni-moono\player and print the Steam launch options:
Then paste the printed line into Steam: Oxygen Not Included -> Properties -> Launch Options.
Or launch the game directly, passing the game folder:
The optional tweaks are on the main menu, under Mods (Moono Tweaks). Clear the launch options to play the original game.
